name: CGN Nuclear Technology Development Co., Ltd.
summary: CGN Nuclear Technology Development Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of electron accelerators in China. The company offers high-energy linear accelerator, earth nano accelerator, electronic curtain accelerator, dg resonant transformer type accelerator, industrial flaw detection accelerator, and electron beam. It also provides irradiation sterilization and polymer material irradiation modification services.
